title: Schedule I tests.
bodyText: A substance shall be placed in schedule I if it has the highest degree of danger or probable danger according to the determination made pursuant to section 329-11.
bodyHtml: [§329-13]  Schedule I tests.  A substance shall be placed in schedule I if it has the highest degree of danger or probable danger according to the determination made pursuant to section 329-11. [L 1972, c 10, pt of §1]
